title: _poll.poll(None) passes 0 instead of blocking on macOS/BSD, causing drain_events() to busy-spin
author: MaxFreedomPollard

author: ChristianMurphy

title: Memory queue purges can race with consumers and raise IndexError
author: IlyaKhalafi
body_preview: The memory transport counts messages through `Queue.qsize()` and then clears `Queue.queue` outside the queue mutex.
